```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]

# 다른 티커로 렌더링 시: quarto render dashboard.qmd -P ticker:AAPL
ticker = "BA"

import helpers
stock = helpers.get_stock(ticker)
data = helpers.get_data(stock)

from IPython.display import Markdown
Markdown("**{symbol}** --- {longName} --- [{website}]({website})"
    .format(**stock.info))

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Current Price"
dict(
    icon = "currency-dollar",
    color = "secondary",
    value = helpers.get_price(data)
)

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Change"
change = helpers.get_change(data)
dict(
    value = change['amount'],
    icon = change['icon'],
    color = change['color']
)

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent Change"
dict(
    icon = "percent",
    color = "light",
    value = change['percent'],
)

#| title: Price History
#| padding: 0
helpers.make_candlestick_chart(data, ticker.upper())

ohlc = helpers.make_OHLC_table(data)
